name: dsh-restart-wake
description: Restart DeepSeek Harness safely and wake sessions automatically afterwards. The same package also carries self-healing: when a kernel change breaks Harness, the watchdog rolls back, restarts, verifies, brings the model back online, and injects the crash scene into the affected session so the model can fix it itself. 让 Agent 安全重启 DeepSeek Harness 并自动唤醒原会话；同一个包内置自愈——改内核改坏了，看门狗回滚重启校验、把模型救回在线，并把故障现场注入原会话，由模型自己动手修。
author: zgq0106 (https://github.com/zgq0106)
